Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Discogs release information and conflated the B-side “Cold Cold Heart” (written by Hank Williams) with the A-side “Turn Me On,” leading to the wrong attribution. This ignored earlier reliable evidence (e.g., Wikipedia and Discogs snippets) that “Turn Me On” was written by John D. Loudermilk, and prematurely instructed delivering the incorrect answer based on a misinterpreted credit.
